description: Parthian tactics centered on highly mobile cavalry, especially horse archers and heavily armored cataphracts. Mounted archers harassed enemy formations with repeated volleys while avoiding close combat, often feigning retreat and shooting backward in the famous “Parthian shot.” Once an opponent became disordered, exhausted, or stretched out in pursuit, armored lancers could deliver powerful shock charges. This combination of mobility, missile fire, deception, and sudden close combat made Parthian armies particularly effective against slower infantry-heavy forces.
requirementsTooltip: Unlocked in City Phase. Requires “Archery Tradition” and “Advanced Cavalry.”
